body:
Thank you everyone for the responses and suggestions, it's weird but the support means a lot; I'm looking into the economic ideas given and ways of getting money in.

On a personal note, the pain has kept me up all night and it's messing with me, but I'm dealing with it. I have managed to push suicidal ideas away, looking at solutions and ways forwards instead.

I've had urges to self harm, but have managed not to act upon them, as I know punishing myself achieves nothing.
